title: Adjoint method
subtitle: All derivatives from one transposed solve

lines.tex: \partial_\theta m = \langle \htmlClass{term-adjoint}{q},\, (I - A)^{-1} z \rangle, \quad z = (\partial_\theta A)\, x
lines.label: pixel $m$, sensor $\htmlClass{term-adjoint}{q}$ · forward mode: one solve per parameter

lines.tex: \begin{aligned} & \langle u,\, A z \rangle = \langle A^\top u,\, z \rangle \\[12pt] & \langle \htmlClass{term-adjoint}{q},\, \textstyle\sum_k A^k z \rangle = \textstyle\sum_k \langle (A^\top)^k \htmlClass{term-adjoint}{q},\, z \rangle \\ & \hphantom{\langle \htmlClass{term-adjoint}{q},\, \textstyle\sum_k A^k z \rangle} = \langle (I - A^\top)^{-1} \htmlClass{term-adjoint}{q},\, z \rangle \end{aligned}
lines.label: adjoint $A^\top$, applied $k$ times
